product_overview: Rinasa is an end-to-end catering operations platform that helps teams manage authentication, inventory, kitchen orders, attendance, waste logging, and deliveries through a Laravel REST API. It supports role-based workflows for admins, chefs, employees, and drivers with mobile-first operational visibility.
core_goals: Provide secure token-based authentication and role-based access control for all operational users.
Enable inventory visibility and item tracking for catering materials and ingredients.
Support order and kitchen operations through order listing and creation workflows.
Allow employees to track attendance and submit waste logs with operational accountability.
Give drivers access to assigned deliveries and related delivery workflow data.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Allows users to register, log in, and log out using token-based authentication, with support in the PRD for role-based routing and session persistence.
user_flows: POST /api/register with valid user details -> Receive 200/201 with created user account -> POST /api/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with authentication token -> Use token for authenticated requests -> POST /api/logout with token -> Receive 200 confirming logout
POST /api/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized error -> User remains unauthenticated and cannot access protected endpoints
POST /api/logout without a valid token -> Receive 401 unauthorized error -> Session remains active on client until a valid token is provided

features.name: Inventory Management
features.description: Provides authenticated access to inventory item listings and item creation for operational stock tracking.
user_flows: GET /api/items with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with inventory item list -> POST /api/items with valid item data and token -> Receive 201 with created inventory item -> GET /api/items with token -> Receive 200 reflecting the new item
GET /api/items without auth token -> Receive 401 unauthorized error -> No inventory data is returned
POST /api/items with invalid or incomplete item data -> Receive 422 validation error -> Inventory item is not created

features.name: Orders and KDS
features.description: Supports kitchen and order operations by allowing authenticated users to list orders and create new orders for preparation workflows.
user_flows: POST /api/orders with valid order data and auth token -> Receive 201 with created order -> GET /api/orders with token -> Receive 200 with order list including the new order -> Kitchen staff reviews active orders in KDS workflow
GET /api/orders with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with current order list -> Orders are available for operational monitoring and kitchen processing
POST /api/orders without auth token -> Receive 401 unauthorized error -> Order is not created
POST /api/orders with invalid order payload -> Receive 422 validation error -> System rejects the order request

features.name: Deliveries
features.description: Allows drivers to view their assigned deliveries through authenticated API access.
user_flows: GET /api/deliveries/my with valid driver auth token -> Receive 200 with assigned delivery list -> Driver reviews routes and delivery details
GET /api/deliveries/my without auth token -> Receive 401 unauthorized error -> No delivery data is returned

features.name: V4 Features
features.description: Introduces waste logging for employees, including submitting waste records and retrieving waste history through authenticated endpoints.
user_flows: POST /api/v4/wastes with valid auth token and waste details -> Receive 201 with created waste log -> GET /api/v4/wastes with token -> Receive 200 with waste log list including the submitted record -> Inventory is updated based on the logged waste
GET /api/v4/wastes with valid auth token -> Receive 200 with waste logs -> Employee or admin reviews historical waste activity
POST /api/v4/wastes without auth token -> Receive 401 unauthorized error -> Waste log is not recorded
POST /api/v4/wastes with invalid waste reason or missing required fields -> Receive 422 validation error -> System rejects the waste submission

features.name: Attendance
features.description: Enables employees to clock in and clock out through a single authenticated attendance endpoint.
user_flows: POST /api/attendance with valid auth token and clock-in data -> Receive 200 with attendance confirmation -> Employee is marked present for the shift
POST /api/attendance again with valid auth token and clock-out data -> Receive 200 with attendance confirmation -> Employee shift is closed successfully
POST /api/attendance without auth token -> Receive 401 unauthorized error -> Attendance is not recorded
POST /api/attendance with invalid GPS, photo, or malformed payload -> Receive 422 validation error -> System rejects the attendance submission
